name: agent-browser
title: Agent Browser
description: Control the agent-browser CLI from Raycast and Raycast AI
author: 0xdhrv

commands.name: browse
commands.title: Open in Agent Browser
commands.description: Open a URL in a visible agent-browser session

tools.name: open-browser
tools.title: Open Browser
tools.description: Open a URL in an isolated session; Dia results report native inspection and interaction readiness

tools.name: inspect-page
tools.title: Inspect Page
tools.description: Read and inspect the active Chromium or Dia page, wait for page state, or navigate browser history

tools.name: interact-with-page
tools.title: Interact with Page
tools.description: Interact with Chromium or Dia page elements and text fields; use Type with Virtual Keyboard for on-screen keyboard input

tools.name: type-with-keyboard
tools.title: Type with Virtual Keyboard
tools.description: Type exact text with validated virtual-key refs, optionally submit, wait, and verify the settled page

tools.name: close-browser
tools.title: Close Browser
tools.description: Close a named agent-browser session and discard its transient browser state after confirmation

preferences.name: executablePath
preferences.title: Agent Browser Executable
preferences.description: Command name or full path to the agent-browser executable

preferences.name: showBrowserWindow
preferences.title: Browser Visibility
preferences.description: Show the browser window when Raycast AI starts an Agent Browser session
preferences.label: Open AI sessions in a visible browser window

preferences.name: browserApplication
preferences.title: Browser Application
preferences.description: Optional browser for Agent Browser sessions, including Chrome, Brave, Edge, Vivaldi, Dia, and Safari

preferences.name: browserProfile
preferences.title: Default Browser Profile or Dia Space
preferences.description: Optional Chromium profile or Dia space name to use, such as Work, Personal, or BOT

preferences.name: browserDataDirectory
preferences.title: Browser Data Directory
preferences.description: Optional Chromium user-data directory for browsers whose profiles cannot be located automatically; it must contain Local State

preferences.name: postInteractionDelayMs
preferences.title: Post-Interaction Delay
preferences.description: Default time to wait after each page interaction before Raycast AI continues

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
